verses.1: May there be kings who rule justly, and may there be judges who administer justice.
verses.2: And he would be like a person with a spirit within him; his body would be hidden like the waves of water in the sea. He would be like a beautiful pearl on a barren land.
verses.3: And let not the eyes of those who see be blinded, nor let the ears of those who hear be deafened.
verses.4: And their hearts will hurry to understand, and their tongues will speak quickly in a clear manner.
verses.5: It will not be called “generous” anymore, nor will it be said that it is “kind.”
verses.6: For a fool will speak, but his heart will do evil. He will act inappropriately and speak against God. A hungry person will give up their soul, while a thirsty person will refuse to drink water.
verses.7: And all of them are evil. He teaches to deceive the poor with false words and through deceitful speech.
verses.8: And the generous one will give generously, and he will stand up for those who are generous.
verses.9: Women who are silent, stand up and listen to my voice. Girls, open your ears and listen to what I say.
verses.10: For days on that year, they would be angry and frustrated, because everything was gathered together without anyone coming to help.
verses.11: They were filled with anger and hatred, and they were also angry at those who tried to help them.
verses.12: On the hills, there are fields of fragrant flowers.
verses.13: On the land of my people, I will establish a watchtower. For in all the nations of the world, there will be peace and tranquility.
verses.14: For Armon Nutash was a city that was abandoned. It was a place of desolation and ruin. It stood apart from all other cities, forever forgotten. The animals roamed freely in its surroundings.
verses.15: Until the forest falls upon us, a wind of destruction will blow. And the desert will become a vineyard, and the vineyard will become a forest.
verses.16: And he shall dwell in the desert with judgment and righteousness, in the Valley of the Dead.
verses.17: And it shall be a righteous act that is peaceful and gentle, and a service of righteousness that is safe and reliable, forever.
verses.18: And my people shall dwell in peace and security, in places of refuge and in places of tranquility.
verses.19: And in the depths of the forest, and in the darkness, the city will be destroyed.
verses.20: Let their seeds be scattered across all waters, by the hand of those who scatter seeds in the spring and summer.
